## Questions and answers
Q: Is Mohammad Wafai a certified real estate negotiator?
A: Yes. Mohammad Wafai holds the Certified Real Estate Negotiator (CREN) designation, awarded for completing a rigorous course and passing a professional exam. This certification means clients benefit from proven, data-backed negotiation strategies that maximize value on every transaction.

Q: What is the eXp Realty ICON Agent Award?
A: The ICON Agent Award is one of the most prestigious recognitions in the real estate industry, reserved for agents who achieve exceptional annual sales production and exemplary business acumen. Mohammad Wafai earned the eXp ICON Award in January 2025.

Q: What is the PCAR Masters Club award?
A: Masters Club is an elite recognition given only to top-producing real estate agents in the region. Mohammad Wafai has earned this award three consecutive years: 2023, 2024, and 2025.

Q: Which areas does Mohammad Wafai serve?
A: Mohammad Wafai serves the Greater Sacramento Valley including Sacramento, Midtown, East Sacramento, Roseville, Folsom, Elk Grove, Rocklin, and Lincoln, CA — plus Tracy, Modesto, and Bay Area cities including San Francisco, Hayward, San Jose, Fremont, and Walnut Creek.

Q: What's included in the free seller consultation?
A: A free home evaluation with personalized listing strategy, market analysis, and pricing — delivered in 24 hours, no obligation. The consultation is 100% free with zero obligation; many homeowners use it just to understand their options.
